title: Setting up a nursery followed by pricking out and potting on
summary: Build your nursery in half a day: site selection, 50/50 potting mix, row sowing, potting on at the 2 true-leaf stage, and hardening off.

pages.title: Creating a complete nursery with potting on
pages.text:
The nursery is the place where seeds are sown and where young seedlings grow before being transplanted into the plots.

A well-organized nursery lets you **save time**, **protect your seedlings** and **optimize your production** (and even sell young plants).

The technique consists of sowing in a starter nursery (in the ground or off the ground), then **potting on the seedlings into pots** before final transplanting. One person can set up the nursery in **half a day**.
pages.illustration_description: Vue d'ensemble en aquarelle botanique d'une pépinière maraîchère ouest-africaine sous ombrière légère : jeunes plants vigoureux dans des contenants recyclés surélevés et petite zone de semis protégée à proximité d'un point d'eau.

pages.title: 1. Why use a nursery and then pot on?
pages.text:
Going through a nursery followed by potting on offers two major advantages:

- Young plants **get stronger** (denser root system) and recover much faster after transplanting.
- It is particularly well suited to crops such as **tomato**, **sweet pepper** or **chili pepper**, which need time to develop before going out to the field.
pages.illustration_description: Étude botanique en aquarelle de jeunes plants forts de tomate, de poivron et de piment, avec des racines bien développées et un feuillage sain.

pages.title: 2. Choosing the right location
pages.text:
Whether your nursery is raised or in the ground, choose an ideal location:

- A **partially shaded** spot, sheltered from wind and heavy downpours.
- An area **close to a water source** to make daily watering easier.

Leave space right next to the starter nursery to set up the plants once they have been potted on.
pages.illustration_description: Espace mi-ombragé sous une légère ombrière en matériaux locaux (paille ou branchages), à côté d'un puits ou d'une réserve d'eau, dans une ferme ouest-africaine paisible.

pages.title: 3. Where to make the first sowings?
pages.text:
At this stage, choose the type of starter nursery best suited to your means:

- **In the ground** (on a small, finely prepared and mulched bed).
- **In a raised nursery**, using cut-open jerrycans or other recycled containers.

Your young plants will grow there until potting on.
pages.illustration_description: Comparaison visuelle en aquarelle entre une petite zone de semis en pleine terre fine au sol et des bidons recyclés coupés en deux remplis de terreau riche posés sur un banc.

pages.title: 4. Preparing a fertile potting mix (50 / 50)
pages.text:
To give your seeds a light and nourishing substrate, mix (for example on a tarp):

- **50% fertile garden soil**
- **50% well-decomposed compost**

Carefully remove large debris and stones that could hinder seed emergence.
pages.illustration_description: Deux mains ouest-africaines mélangeant sur une bâche au sol un tas de terre de jardin brune et un tas de compost sombre bien mûr, en retirant les petits cailloux.

pages.title: 5. Setting up the raised structure (if needed)
pages.text:
If you opt for a raised nursery:

- Use **split jerrycans** or **recycled pots** with holes pierced in the bottom.
- Place a layer of **sand and/or small stones** at the bottom to ensure good drainage.
- Add your layer of potting mix.
- Set everything on a raised structure (table or bench) and, if needed, protect it with an **insect net** against insects.
pages.illustration_description: Coupe en aquarelle d'un bidon recyclé coupé en deux posé sur une table rustique, montrant au fond une couche de petits cailloux et sable pour le drainage, surmontée d'une couche épaisse de terreau sombre.

pages.title: 6. Sowing in the starter nursery
pages.text:
To ensure good emergence in your starter nursery:

1. Sow your seeds **in rows**, in small straight furrows.
2. Press the seeds lightly into the furrow.
3. Cover them with a **thin layer of potting mix**.
4. **Water gently** with a very fine spray, without displacing the seeds.
pages.illustration_description: Mains ouest-africaines semant de fines graines en petites lignes droites dans le terreau d'une pépinière, puis arrosant délicatement avec un arrosoir à pomme fine.

pages.title: 7. When to pot on the young plants?
pages.text:
At emergence, young seedlings come out of the soil with **cotyledons**, which look like leaves but are not.

Wait until **2 true leaves** appear before potting on the seedling. This generally takes **1 to 2 weeks (7 to 14 days)** after sowing.
pages.illustration_description: Étude botanique en aquarelle de deux stades d'une jeune pousse de tomate : à gauche une plantule avec seulement ses deux cotylédons allongés, à droite une plantule prête au repiquage avec ses deux premières vraies feuilles découpées.

pages.title: 8. How to pot on the young plants?
pages.text:
1. Fill the pots with potting mix, leaving a little space at the top.
2. Carefully lift each seedling, keeping **as many roots as possible**.
3. Replant it in the center of the pot and top up with potting mix if needed.
4. **Water gently and right away**.
5. **Do not place** freshly potted-on plants in full sun.
pages.illustration_description: Une agricultrice ouest-africaine repiquant délicatement une jeune plantule à deux vraies feuilles dans un petit pot rempli de terreau sombre, à l'ombre d'une ombrière.

pages.title: 9. Setting up and protecting the pots
pages.text:
To protect your potted-on plants from animals, soil-borne diseases and pests:

- Place the pots on a **raised structure** (table or bench).
- If needed, cover them with an **insect net** or fine mesh against insects.
pages.illustration_description: Rangées de petits pots contenant de jeunes plants verts posés sur une table rustique surélevée, protégés par une moustiquaire légère tendue sur des arceaux souples.

pages.title: 10. Caring for and hardening off the potted-on plants
pages.text:
Until transplanting to the field:

- **Water regularly**, without excess, to keep the potting mix moist.
- **Monitor** for the appearance of diseases and remove weak plants if needed.
- **Hardening off**: a few days before final transplanting, gradually accustom the plants to full sun so they can withstand the change.
pages.illustration_description: Un agriculteur ouest-africain déplaçant des pots de jeunes plants robustes de la zone mi-ombragée vers une zone plus ensoleillée pour les acclimater avant la plantation au champ.

pages.title: Well done! Your young plants are ready
pages.text:
**Well done!** You now know how to create a complete nursery and successfully pot on seedlings before transplanting them into your growing beds.

Healthy, vigorous plants from the nursery stage onward are the key to abundant harvests!
pages.illustration_description: Belle collection de jeunes plants vigoureux et homogènes dans leurs pots, prêts à être transplantés vers les planches permanentes en pleine terre visibles en arrière-plan.
